node.title: Re^2: perl one-liner to serve httpd current directory
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Perl actually removed the core HTTP request processing modules in 2014.

Which modules are that? [mod://CGI].pm was removed in Perl 5.022, but CGI is not HTTP (and to be extra nitpicky, 5.022 wasn't released until 2015).
